keys: L{L}_Wf [hidden, experts] f16, L{L}_bf [experts] f32, L{L}_A [experts, experts] f16
formula: s_T = x_L @ Wf + bf + A[ids_L].sum(0); x_L = layer L's MoE input (the router's input, raw: the fit's standardization is folded into Wf and bf) per row; ids_L = the experts routed at L for that row; s_T = scores of layer T = L + 2's experts; the A/B pick rule: top-K over all experts by s_T, resident ones skipped
